children: Injective-native assets such as PONS can now be transferred and traded directly on Robinhood Crypto, extending support for Injective-ecosystem tokens to a major retail trading venue. Holders no longer need a separate route to move these assets into the app, since deposits, withdrawals, and trading are handled natively within Robinhood's crypto platform.

Direct support on Robinhood broadens distribution for Injective-native assets by placing them in front of a large retail user base that previously had no native access to them. For tokens like PONS, availability on a mainstream app can increase visibility and make inflows easier, since users can buy, sell, and custody the asset without leaving the platform. The effect on liquidity depends on how many assets qualify and how actively they trade, but the change removes a practical access barrier for INJ-ecosystem tokens in one of the largest retail crypto channels.
